Initial release of lel-mail: Send, read, and manage email from the command line.

- Supports Gmail configuration for SMTP (sending) and IMAP (reading).
- Provides scripts to check emails and send emails with scheduling.
- Requires a config file at `~/.config/lel-mail/config.json`.
- Supports CC and BCC fields for outgoing emails.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance for setup and errors.
